verdicts.title: Diophantine approximation on matrices and Lie groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the general problem of extremality for metric Diophantine approximation on submanifolds of matrices. We formulate a criterion for extremality in terms of a certain family of algebraic obstructions and show that it is sharp. In general, the almost sure diophantine exponent of a submanifold is shown to depend only on its Zariski closure, and when the latter is defined over the rational numbers, we prove that the exponent is rational and give a method to effectively compute it. verdicts.title: Primes Solutions Of Linear Diophantine Equations
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let k => 1, m => 1 be small fixed integers, gcd(k, m) = 1. This note develops some techniques for proving the existence of infinitely many primes solutions x = p, and y = q of the linear Diophantine equation y = mx + k.
